'''Figg Excavations''' ('''FiggEx''') was a subsidiary company of the [[Outer Javin Company]], headquartered on [[Gerrenthum/Legends|Gerrenthum]].

==History==
It mined heavily on [[Ione/Legends|Ione]] and was a member corporation of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]]. The company lost respect and profit when it was discovered they were hiring [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] to attack their own convoys as a means to gain the protection of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] police forces and split from the Mining Guild.
